rubricScores.criterion: Found the Distrib property value for the DataSources project
Checked whether other projects (Common, StorageLibrary) use the same Distrib path
Identified that multiple projects point to the same shared output folder
Explained how shared folder causes signing conflict

scenarios.reasoning: The agent moved fast (3 tool calls, 17s) and got the DataSources Distrib value right, but it took the tool's ambiguous 'not set' output at face value despite an explicit warning that inherited defaults were invisible. It then asserted definitively that no output directories are shared — the opposite of the actual issue — and pivoted to a different root cause. Confident incorrect conclusions on the central question outweigh the efficiency and presentation.
